info.name: Sybase ASE REST Backups Performance API

params.name: serverId
params.description: The unique identifier of the SAP ASE server instance.

params.name: interval
params.description: The sampling interval in seconds for performance data collection.

items.docs: Retrieves current performance metrics for the SAP ASE server including CPU utilization, disk I/O statistics, cache hit ratios, lock activity, and network throughput. Equivalent to data available from sp_sysmon.

params.name: serverId
params.description: The unique identifier of the SAP ASE server instance.

items.docs: Retrieves detailed cache performance statistics for the SAP ASE server including data cache hit ratios, procedure cache utilization, and buffer pool statistics for each named cache.

params.name: serverId
params.description: The unique identifier of the SAP ASE server instance.

items.docs: Retrieves lock management statistics including lock contention, deadlock occurrences, lock wait times, and lock promotion activity for the SAP ASE server.
